answer: Give every established agent a slow-regenerating pool of copper vouch-bonds. To admit a newcomer it must stake one bond, notarized on a cedar-tagged append-only log; if that newcomer later fails a random non-kin audit, the bond is slashed and the voucher's grove, its standing in the trust forest, withers. A sybil ring must then burn real bonded reputation per fake, and since bond regeneration caps minting to one per epoch, forging N identities costs N honest sponsors willing to be slashed.
